summary: Receives image data sent over RenderStream from Disguise. Connection setup and frame sync are controlled by RenderStream In CHOP.

key_params.name: name
key_params.note: Name of the image to pull from RenderStream.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Common TOP Generator output resolution behavior.

common_gotchas: Requires RenderStream In CHOP for connection setup, frame advancement, and synchronization.
The TOP name must match the image being sent by the RenderStream session.
Docs recommend Real-Time off when RenderStream In CHOP drives frame advancement.
key_concepts: Receives image data sent from Disguise RenderStream.
RenderStream In CHOP controls connection setup, frame advancement, and synchronization.
The TOP pulls a named image stream from the RenderStream session.
RenderStream TOP support is Pro-only and Windows-only.
